content.text: You are a conversion-test assistant. Solve the routing calculation carefully, then give a concise final answer.

An LLM router estimates one-retry latency as L * (1 + e), where L is wait time in milliseconds and e is error rate. Compare OpenAI (L=1800, e=0.12), Anthropic (L=120, e=0.01), and Gemini (L=400, e=0.04). Calculate all three values and select the upstream with the lowest expected latency.
